name: claude-analytics
description: Query the Claude Code Analytics API from a CLI and a self-hosted React app, joined to a developer attributes CSV.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "node --import tsx --watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "npm run dev -w @claude-analytics/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && node --import tsx apps/server/src/index.ts
